notes: Fixed the 'Start Wi-Fi produces no AP broadcast, no error, no output' bug. Two real bugs found: (1) field_console.py's start_ap() had 'while not ap.active(): time.sleep(0.2)' with NO TIMEOUT -- if the CYW43439 radio wasn't ready yet right after the machine.reset() that got here (same shared-radio settle issue already worked around on the BLE side), this hung forever silently: no error, no AP, no console output, matching exactly what was reported. Now times out after 8s with a clear diagnostic, and disables BLE + waits 250ms before ap.active(True) (mirrors ble_service.py's ensure_wifi_off(), mirrored for the AP side). (2) main.py had a worse bug hiding underneath: 'import field_console' (which starts the AP) sat inside the SAME try block as the os.stat('wifi_mode.txt') existence check, and 'except OSError:' was checked before 'except Exception:'. Any OSError raised while starting the Wi-Fi AP -- exactly what bug (1) could produce, or a socket bind failure, etc -- landed in that first branch and was silently misreported as 'no wifi_mode.txt file, starting BLE instead', masking the real Wi-Fi AP error completely. main.py now determines which mode was requested BEFORE trying to start either one, so a real failure starting the AP is reported as what it actually is.
